scheme.implementing_agency: SIDBI, Scheduled Commercial Banks, RRBs, SFBs, Cooperative Banks, NBFCs, MFIs, SHG Banks, Indian Bank (PAiSA portal)
scheme.description: Central Sector Scheme. Initial working capital loan up to Rs 10,000 for 1 year (generic FAQ). Interest subsidy at 7%. Monthly cashback incentive on digital transactions (Rs 50 on 50 transactions; additional Rs 25 on next 50; additional Rs 25 on next 100; max Rs 100/month). Higher loan on timely repayment. No collateral required. Scheme implemented up to March 2022 per FAQ 8.
scheme.voice_summary: PM SVANidhi gives street vendors working capital loans without collateral, starting at up to 10000 rupees, with a 7 percent interest subsidy and cashback on digital payments.
benefits: First tranche working capital loan up to Rs 10,000 with 1-year repayment tenure
Second tranche enhanced working capital loan up to Rs 20,000 upon timely or early repayment of first tranche
Third tranche working capital loan up to Rs 50,000 upon timely repayment of second tranche
Interest subsidy at 7% per annum credited quarterly directly into beneficiary bank account via DBT
Monthly cashback incentive: Rs 50 for first 50 transactions, additional Rs 25 for next 50, and Rs 25 for next 100 eligible digital transactions
eligibility: Must have been vending in urban areas as on or before March 24, 2020
application_process: offline: Visit nearest CSC, Municipal Corporation office, or bank branch for application submission.
offline: Collect Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from Town Vending Committee (TVC) if not possessing ID card.
online: Access PM SVANidhi portal (pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in) or PM SVANidhi mobile app.
online: Enter mobile number and verify via OTP.
online: Select vendor category: (A) Vendors with Vending Card/LoR, (B) Vendors left out of survey, (C) Surrounding rural vendors.
online: Upload KYC documents and select preferred lending institution / bank.
online: Submit loan application for 1st tranche (up to Rs 10,000).

procedure_steps.text: Visit nearest CSC, Municipal Corporation office, or bank branch for application submission.
Collect Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from Town Vending Committee (TVC) if not possessing ID card.
Access PM SVANidhi portal (pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in) or PM SVANidhi mobile app.
Enter mobile number and verify via OTP.
Select vendor category: (A) Vendors with Vending Card/LoR, (B) Vendors left out of survey, (C) Surrounding rural vendors.
Upload KYC documents and select preferred lending institution / bank.
Submit loan application for 1st tranche (up to Rs 10,000).

faqs.question: What are the loan amounts and interest subsidy available under PM SVANidhi?
faqs.answer: PM SVANidhi offers working capital loans: 1st tranche up to Rs. 10,000 (1-year tenure); 2nd tranche up to Rs. 20,000; and 3rd tranche up to Rs. 50,000 upon timely repayment, with 7% interest subsidy per annum and up to Rs. 1,200 annual cashback on digital transactions.
